item.title: Cloudflare Workers: pricing/limits page changed
item.description: Added/changed: Oct 12, 2026 | Cloudflare regularly updates the Workers runtime. During routine updates, processes running the previous version of the Workers runtime give existing Workers requests and connections up to 20 minutes to finish. This includes streaming HTTP responses and WebSocket connections. — Removed: Oct 8, 2026 | Cloudflare updates the Workers runtime a few times per week. The runtime gives in-flight requests a 30-second grace period to finish. If a request does not finish within this time, the runtime terminates it. This scenario is very unlikely because it requires a long-running request to coincide with a runtime update.
